summary: feat(immoscout24): group expose inspect texts by property-facing section
reason: The previous expose inspect text output recursively emitted every scalar string from the mobile expose JSON, so agent workflows saw ad-targeting metadata, form states, and UI labels before the actual listing wording. Apartment review needs the visible expose sections, attributes, and descriptions in source order.
validated_outcome: go test ./... passed; live expose inspect 168983602 changed from 533 recursive text hits to 45 structured text items with TOP_ATTRIBUTES, TITLE, Hauptkriterien, Kosten, and TEXT_AREA groups; live expose inspect 169007317 returned structured TOP_ATTRIBUTES, TITLE, and Hauptkriterien groups; --max-texts 8 returned exactly 8 structured items.
findings_addressed: Replace recursive text hits with grouped property-facing text sections in expose inspect output
Exclude adTargetingParameters, contact form state, ads, tracking, and service-provider payloads from texts
Keep image, floorplan, and link extraction behavior intact while preserving useful section paths
Update agent-facing examples from texts.value to texts.title and texts.items.value
